jobs.title: Implement the spec form-builder module
jobs.objective: Build kayakgen/ui/web/generate_spec_form.py with a public render_spec_form_section(app) that renders a form-builder primary view (variables, algorithm radio with per-algorithm sub-fields, objectives multi-select filtered live by claim-admissibility, evaluators toggles including a per-job CFD-in-loop opt-in row with explicit acknowledgement, budget, soft 4-job in-flight warning) plus a collapsible raw-JSON escape hatch. Pre-fill base_hull from the current single-hull view and seed sensible defaults (NSGA-II population_size=12 generations=4, budget=64). Display-only metrics (RFC 0043) and claim-admissibility refusals (RFC 0044) must never appear in the objectives picklist; admissibility errors surface inline next to the offending row. Do not edit app.py — the integrator wires this module into the Generate tab.

jobs.title: Implement the Pareto frontier view module
jobs.objective: Build kayakgen/ui/web/generate_frontier_view.py with a public render_frontier_view_section(app) that renders a 2D scatter (objective-pair picker; point color by claim_state, shape by ConvergenceFlag from RFC 0052) synced with a sortable table. For 3-objective EHVI runs, expose an objective-pair selector and surface the third objective as a colour-mapped axis on the scatter plus a column in the table. Clicking a candidate row triggers full handoff into the single-hull view (replace parameter rail, rebuild 3D scene) with a one-click undo toast. Stay within forbidden-copy: no max_gz_m / heel_at_max_gz_deg / range_positive_stability_deg / fixture_only / OpenFOAM / hosted strings. Do not edit app.py — the integrator wires this module into the Generate tab.

jobs.title: Implement the Generate panel auto-poll state listener
jobs.objective: Build kayakgen/ui/web/generate_state_listener.py with a public install_generate_state_listener(app) that uses Trame timers or state-change callbacks to auto-refresh the Generate panel: 1-second cadence while any job state is in (queued, running), 10-second cadence otherwise. Poll calls into the existing manager.list() helper; on transition succeeded/failed/resumable, fire one additional refresh of the per-job detail panels. The listener must be cancellable and must not duplicate manual Refresh Jobs presses. Do not edit app.py — the integrator wires this module into the Generate tab.

jobs.title: Flip kayakgen serve to subprocess by default
jobs.objective: Flip the kayakgen serve default generative-job manager from InProcessGenerativeJobManager to SubprocessGenerativeJobManager. Rename the existing --jobs-subprocess flag: --jobs-in-process becomes the explicit in-process opt-in. Default behavior with no flag is now subprocess. Update tests/test_cli_serve.py (or its equivalent) to cover both paths. Print the chosen manager kind to the operator on startup so the deviation is visible. Do not touch app.py — the integrator wires the manager construction; only the CLI flag plumbing changes here.

jobs.title: Implement log redaction for the generative-jobs log payload
jobs.objective: Add a _redact_log_text(text, *, home_dir, jobs_root) helper to kayakgen/services/generative_jobs.py and route generative_job_log_payload through it before returning. Replace any occurrence of the operator's $HOME prefix with ~, and rewrite paths that begin with the resolved jobs_root to start with <jobs_root>. Preserve byte-stable behavior for log payloads whose lines contain no absolute paths. Add a dedicated tests/test_log_redaction.py module that asserts redaction for a fabricated log containing both $HOME and jobs_root paths, and a no-op assertion for a log without any.

jobs.title: Implement Fork-with-new-seed route + manager primitive + button module
jobs.objective: Add kayakgen/services/generative_jobs_fork.py with fork_generative_job_payload(manager, source_job_id, *, new_seed) that loads the source spec, patches algorithm.seed (NSGA-II) or algorithm.seed (EHVI), and calls manager.start with the patched spec_payload. The new job's GenerativeJob carries the forked-from job_id in a new optional forked_from field. Add POST /api/generative-jobs/{job_id}/fork to kayakgen/ui/web/controllers.py (accepts {"new_seed": int}). Add kayakgen/ui/web/generate_fork_button.py with render_fork_button(app, job_summary) that displays a 'Fork with new seed' button on succeeded rows; click POSTs to the new route and refreshes the jobs list. New tests in tests/test_generative_jobs_fork.py.
